cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says taxpayers can file returns online; AGT's July 2026 rule makes payment electronic through the Portal do Contribuinte.
cells.note: AGT ruled in July 2026 that taxes are paid electronically through the Portal do Contribuinte (AGO-004), but no source says returns can be filed online, and each rung must be met, so 2 holds on the SIGT/SIIAT project (AGO-001, AGO-002).
